name: netsuite-approval-review
description: Double-checks the NetSuite bills, purchase orders and change orders sitting in your approval queue and publishes the findings to a live dashboard. Verifies invoice math, judges whether the supporting document is adequate, cross-checks the real purchase order and billing history, and links each item to its NetSuite record. The dashboard is read-only. Skill version 34 — 2026-09-24.
